correctness.rationale: Two independent exhaustive stdlib scripts generate the complete 18,024 proper 4-colorings and all 64,320 Hamming-one edges using different state/edge algorithms, verify I exactly +/-3 on the two 9,012 connected sectors, and confirm each claim by direct enumeration. Verified group action reduces all-root eccentricities to 108 fully checked BFS representatives, giving radius 16 and diameter 20. Hamming-two crossing count 11,616 independently checked. Published Theorem 2 at k=5 plus 5 not dividing 12 proves five-color connectivity. No sampled or infinite proof claim.

value.rationale: Optimal-palette recolouring of the smallest triangle-free four-chromatic four-regular graph is a motivated natural stress test of Glauber dynamics. The result identifies an explicit complete obstruction involving eleven natural oriented rainbow quadrangles, a non-frozen two-sector phase split, all distances and the minimum simultaneous escape size; neither the known count alone nor the generic five-colour theorem supplies this structure. This is a substantial finite classification, without claiming a universal result.
